visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a middle-aged male chef in a professional white uniform stir-frying vegetables in a black wok. He is smiling and looking at the camera. The setting is a clean, bright studio kitchen with white cabinets and a gas stove. (2) A sequence of fast cuts shows a whole fish being fried and flipped in the pan with a spatula. The non-stick quality is visually emphasized. A split screen appears, contrasting gas flame intensity and showing a reduction in cooking smoke and oil. (3) Macro close-up shots reveal the technical design of the pan, including the honeycomb-textured interior and the 'CUOCO' logo on the silver bottom. The chef's hands are seen demonstrating the comfortable grip of the black handle. Multiple SGS safety certificates overlay the screen. (4) The final phase presents two different models of the pan, one deeper and one shallower, both with glass lids, sitting side-by-side on a white countertop. The chef gestures towards them as the brand logo and slogan 'Safety and Durability' remain visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Professional male narration begins with a clear inquiry about kitchenware. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track with bright guitar strums and a steady beat. The studio environment is perfectly quiet with no ambient noise. (2) A sharp transition whoosh SFX occurs as the narrator emphasizes three key attributes. The vocal pitch remains stable and authoritative. The music remains at a consistent volume, providing a energetic bed for the speech. (3) The sound of food sizzling in a hot pan becomes audible, specifically a high-frequency frying noise. The narrator explains the Korean manufacturing and non-stick coating. The BGM and vocals are mixed with high clarity. (4) A digital chime SFX rings out to highlight a specific feature. The voice tone is enthusiastic and friendly. The music continues without interruption, maintaining the pace of the advertisement. (5) Another whoosh SFX marks the shift to technical details about the IH bottom and ergonomic handle. The narrator's speech rate is consistent, with clear articulation. The BGM remains the dominant non-vocal element. (6) A final set of transition SFX sounds as SGS reports are mentioned. The narrator concludes with a positive, rising intonation. The music reaches a final chord and fades out as the segment ends.
